The device identifier. When a subscription is requested, it is sent to the VPN provider and added to the list of connected devices. HWID spoofing lets you request a subscription on behalf of another device.

When requesting subscriptions, all VPN apps report information about themselves to the provider (usually name and version). Happwner lets you request subscriptions on behalf of any app allowed by the VPN provider.

Happanion is a companion app for Happwner with functions for rare cases. Features:

• Decrypts Happ links using Happ\'s own library;
• Hands Happ\'s browser links to Happwner.

This app installs instead of Happ from Google Play. You\'ll be prompted to remove the original app if it\'s installed.

Happwner will embed its Xposed module into the selected app using LSPortable, then offer to install or reinstall it. Reinstalling erases all of the app\'s data. Neither the hooks nor the app itself is guaranteed to work after patching.

What Happwner can do inside target/patched apps:

• Intercept the real link when importing an encrypted one;
• Intercept and spoof the HWID;
• Pass intent links to Happwner;
• Access profile settings for encrypted subscriptions (Happ and v2RayTun only);
• Open Happwner with three simultaneous taps.

This feature allows updating subscriptions through any proxy client (Hiddify, husi, v2rayNG and many others).

After clicking \"OK\", Happwner will request permission to display notifications and run in the background, start the service, and copy the link to the clipboard—import it into your app.

Important: enable \"Bypass LAN\" or add a geoip:private rule to direct, otherwise the update will not work when your proxy client\'s connection is active.

Tap \"Subscription\" on the main screen, add the copied link to your app, and update the subscription there from now on.

Important: enable \"Bypass LAN\" or add a geoip:private rule to direct, otherwise the update will not work when your proxy client\'s connection is active.
